sentences.text:
Accordingly, he paid the remaining amount and thereafter, the solar panel was not installed,
neither his amount was repaid and thus, he was duped for the amount of Rs.1,35,000/-.
On the basis of the said report, police have registered the crime against the present applicant.

3. Learned Counsel for the applicant submitted that as far as the allegations are concerned, it reveals that the informant has deposited the amount in the account of the present applicant on the say of her partner.
As regards the transaction there is no actual participation of the present applicant and therefore, her custodial interrogation is not required and she be protected by granting ad-interim protection.

4. Learned APP strongly opposed the said application on the ground that considering the allegation in the FIR which shows that not only the other co-accused but present applicant has also demanded the amount and accordingly, the  (3) 914.aba.266.2024 complainant has deposited the amount and therefore,
her custodial interrogation is required.
5.

After perusal of the recitals of the FIR and considering the transaction it reveals that towards the installation of the solar panel, some amount was deposited in the account of the present applicant and in fact, the solar panel was not installed.

Thus, at the most, the transaction which is in the civil nature,
immediate custodial interrogation is not required.
In view of that, present applicant can be protected by granting ad-interim protection.
Accordingly, I proceed to pass following order.

ORDER (i) In the event of arrest, the applicant Shweta Ashok Jatap shall be released on ad-interim anticipatory bail, on executing PR bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one solvent surety in the like amount, in connection with Crime No.55/2024 registered with Police Station Jaripatka, District Nagpur for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 409 and 420 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
